parameters.query:
-- Pre-Flight Check: Ensure all dimensions are ready
SELECT 
  'FACT_LOAD_PREFLIGHT' as status,
  NOW() as check_time,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_dwh.dim_date) as dates_loaded,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_dwh.dim_products) as products_loaded,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_dwh.dim_customers) as customers_loaded,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_staging.stg_transactions WHERE data_quality_flag = 'VALID') as staging_valid_records,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT StockCode) FROM ecommerce_staging.stg_transactions WHERE data_quality_flag = 'VALID') as staging_unique_products,
  CASE 
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_dwh.dim_date) = 0 THEN '❌ dim_date is EMPTY'
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_dwh.dim_products) = 0 THEN '❌ dim_products is EMPTY'
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_staging.stg_transactions WHERE data_quality_flag = 'VALID') = 0 THEN '❌ No VALID staging data'
    ELSE '✅ All dimensions ready'
  END as preflight_status

nodes.notes:

⚠️ Checks for empty tables
📊 Shows record counts
✅ Ensures data integrity

-- Join Test: Verify how many records will be loaded
SELECT 
  'JOIN_TEST' as test_type,
  COUNT(*) as records_that_will_load,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.InvoiceNo) as unique_invoices,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_key) as unique_products_matched,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_key) as unique_customers_matched,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN c.customer_key IS NULL THEN 1 END) as records_without_customer,
  ROUND(SUM(s.TotalAmount), 2) as total_revenue,
  MIN(s.InvoiceDate) as earliest_sale,
  MAX(s.InvoiceDate) as latest_sale,
  NOW() as test_time
FROM ecommerce_staging.stg_transactions s
INNER JOIN ecommerce_dwh.dim_products p ON s.StockCode = p.StockCode
LEFT JOIN ecommerce_dwh.dim_customers c ON s.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE s.data_quality_flag = 'VALID'

nodes.name: JOIN Test & Preview
nodes.notes:
🔍 Tests JOIN logic before INSERT
📊 Shows exactly what will load
⚠️ Identifies unmatched records
💰 Previews revenue totals

-- Load Fact Sales with Duplicate Prevention
INSERT INTO fact_sales (
  date_key, customer_key, product_key, InvoiceNo, Quantity,
  UnitPrice, TotalAmount, Country, is_cancelled, is_return, transaction_hour
)
SELECT 
  DATE_FORMAT(s.InvoiceDate, '%Y%m%d') as date_key,
  c.customer_key,
  p.product_key,
  s.InvoiceNo,
  s.Quantity,
  s.UnitPrice,
  s.TotalAmount,
  s.Country,
  s.is_cancelled,
  s.is_return,
  HOUR(s.InvoiceDate) as transaction_hour
FROM ecommerce_staging.stg_transactions s
INNER JOIN ecommerce_dwh.dim_products p ON s.StockCode = p.StockCode
LEFT JOIN ecommerce_dwh.dim_customers c ON s.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE s.data_quality_flag = 'VALID'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ecommerce_dwh.fact_sales f
    WHERE f.InvoiceNo = s.InvoiceNo
      AND f.product_key = p.product_key
      AND f.date_key = DATE_FORMAT(s.InvoiceDate, '%Y%m%d')
      AND ABS(f.TotalAmount - s.TotalAmount) < 0.01
  )
